The main takeaway from our work is that
NN modelling is a powerful tool that could be used to predict and optimize the effects of dietary amino acids on broiler chicken growth performance and carcass composition.
NN models can be used to develop a comprehensive understanding of the effects of DThr and dietary CP on broiler performance at different ages.
neural networks can be used as a tool to predict broiler responses to DThr and optimize the levels of DThr for different traits at different stages of age.
